firstPartyFiles.selection: all current .reds files accepted by tools/Build-OwnedAcceptance.ps1; runtime activation gates are opened only in immutable staged copies

redscript.reason: Merged Biology runtime and presentation use narrow additive/wrapper seams whose whole-file REDmod replacement would broaden patch/conflict surface.

mod-settings.reason: PR #33 made the two preference semantics provider-neutral but did not implement another accessible persistent settings surface. Removing Mod Settings now would remove the attended-test path for master disable and E3 ON/OFF.

archivexl.reason: Retained solely because the current Mod Settings adapter depends on it.

red4ext.reason: Retained solely as transitive plumbing for ArchiveXL/Mod Settings; Biology has no project-owned RED4ext DLL/plugin.

rules: mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod package identity.
Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 must exact-compile the complete merged REDscript runtime against the supported installed Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 bundle before it emits a playable ZIP.
The build may not modify or deploy to the game installation.
Every installed payload file must be individually recorded with owner, component, route, replace policy and SHA-256; shared framework roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
No Dark Future or Project E3 executing content may enter the package.
No stock Cyberpunk executable, archive, script bundle, save, settings file, or other proprietary game payload may enter the package.

Mod Settings/ArchiveXL/RED4ext remain temporary current-candidate dependencies only because the merged presentation lane has not yet supplied another accessible persistent provider for its already provider-neutral semantics.
CI and exact compilation are not live-game acceptance; remaining direct-game gates stay open until the parent integration thread records them.
